order_id.description: Order ID. Echo it back on every POST /trx/{id}/update call.

trx_id.description: Transaction ID (UUID). It also goes in the path of the delivery-status update calls.

product_id.description: Your product id, the same id you send us on POST /products/sync.

amount.description: Amount paid by the customer, in major currency units.

created.description: Timestamp when the transaction order creation was initiated on partner side.

customer.description: Recipient of the goods, and where they ship.

sender.description: The buyer, when the goods were purchased for someone else.
